WILLIAM D. HASSETT, JR.
STATLER HILTON BUILDING
107 DELAWARE AVENUE
BUFFALO, NEW YORK 14202
716-856-3000   716-856-1090

July 27, 1976

Ms. Norma Parish
The Tobacco Institute, Inc.
1776 K Street, N.W.
Washington, D.C. 20006

Dear Norma:

Mr. Hassett is out of town (and I assume Mr.
Dwyer might be traveling, too).

I just talked with Mr. Jack Lewis of our area
Grocery Manufacturers Representatives. They
would definitely be interested in hearing Mr.
Dwyer but they do not meet in the summer months.
Should another visit in the September through
May period be scheduled, by all means contact
Mr. Lewis. The group consists of several
tobacco products people and interested general
membership and they would welcome a presentation
by the Tobacco Institute.

Very truly yours,

Diane
Secretary to Mr. Hassett

cc: Mr. Hassett

TINY 0017324
